o1: Enables ubiquitin-like ligase-substrate adaptor activity. Involved in canonical Wnt signaling pathway; negative regulation of vulval development; and proteasome-mediated ubiquitin-dependent protein catabolic process. Is located in the cell cortex; membrane; and nucleus. Is part of beta-catenin destruction complex. Is expressed in QL; neurons; seam cell; ventral cord blast cell; and vulval precursor cell. Is part of the canonical Wnt signaling pathway.
